# redfish_ami_firmware (Data Source)

Firmware versions of an AMI MegaRAC BMC and its host, as shown on the web UI dashboard. Use it in a check block to assert the expected versions: inside a check block a failed read (for example an unreachable BMC) is only a warning and does not block the apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A failed read inside a check block is only a warning, so an unreachable BMC does not block the apply.
check "bmc_firmware" {
  data "redfish_ami_firmware" "bmc" {
    redfish_server { redfish_alias = "bmc" }
  }

  assert {
    condition     = data.redfish_ami_firmware.bmc.bmc_version == "6.09.00"
    error_message = "BMC runs firmware ${data.redfish_ami_firmware.bmc.bmc_version}, expected 6.09.00."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `redfish_server` (Block List) List of server BMCs and their respective user credentials (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--redfish_server))

### Read-Only

- `bios_version` (String) BIOS version ("N/A" when the board does not report it).
- `bmc_version` (String) BMC firmware version, e.g. 6.09.00 ("N/A" when the board does not report it).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `microcode_version` (String) CPU microcode version ("N/A" when the board does not report it).
- `psp_version` (String) AMD PSP firmware version ("N/A" when the board does not report it).

<a id="nestedblock--redfish_server"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redfish_server`

Optional:

- `endpoint` (String) Server BMC IP address or hostname
- `password` (String, Sensitive) User password for login
- `redfish_alias` (String) Alias name for server BMCs. The key in provider's `redfish_servers` map
- `ssl_insecure` (Boolean) This field indicates whether the SSL/TLS certificate must be verified or not
- `user` (String) User name for login
